1|## Chapter 27 — Martial Law Preparations
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents prepared for dust storms. You prepare for the moment when trust runs out."*  
     4|*General Tomas Hale V: "We're not planning for war. We're preparing for the failure of peace."*  
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a military pulse: Defense Readiness Condition - Elevated to Level 2 (Martial Law Protocol Drafting). General Tomas Hale V adjusted his spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent watching how humans actually prepare for conflict, as he looked at the notification flashing across his console in the Valles Marineris Defense Authority's war room.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," he said, his voice carrying the rasp of years spent in command bunkers and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this alert."
